create_FunFontsAugmenter: create a FunFontsAugmenter instance with word granularity and a fonts JSON file path
load_fonts_from_json: load fun font mappings from a JSON file using the load_fonts method
apply_font_to_text: apply a fun font substitution to text using the apply_font method with word or char mode
substitute_text_with_fonts: substitute words or characters in text with fun font variants using the substitute method
clean_and_check_duplicates: clean text data and check for duplicates using the clean and is_duplicate class methods
